name: Super Saiyan Hair
description: Hold block to grow towering hair that soaks up damage. Full hair: double speed and damage.

displayLines.label: Max health as a hair shield
Move speed and damage while the hair is full
Block to charge (no moving or shooting)

details: Your hat turns into towering spiky hair, and your block bubble is gone. Hold block to power up: you can't move or shoot while charging, but the hair fills a health pool worth 3× your max health that soaks damage before you do. While the hair is completely full you move twice as fast and deal twice the damage; the first hit you take ends it until you charge back up. Full hair is huge, golden and glowing; drained hair shrinks to a dull grey tuft. Faster with Block cooldown and Block duration cards. Starts empty every round.
